# Vendored C-FFI Parser Runtimes

This directory contains the minimal, self-contained C runtime and pre-generated parser tables required by MUZE for concrete syntax tree (CST) analysis across C, C++, and Rust.

## Purpose & Architecture

MUZE operates as a **hermetic, zero-dependency systems framework**. Rather than requiring developers to install `tree-sitter-cli`, Node.js, npm, or system shared libraries (`libtree-sitter.so` / `libtree-sitter.dylib`), MUZE vendors the generated ANSI C source code directly.

Zig's native build system (`build.zig`) compiles these C files directly into the `muze` binary using Zig's embedded C compiler (`zig cc`).

## Directory Contents

| Component | Upstream Repository | Purpose in MUZE |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `tree-sitter/lib/` | [tree-sitter/tree-sitter](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter) | Core C runtime parser engine (`lib.c` unity build & `api.h`) |
| `tree-sitter-c/src/` | [tree-sitter/tree-sitter-c](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-c) | Pre-generated C grammar tables (`parser.c`) |
| `tree-sitter-cpp/src/` | [tree-sitter/tree-sitter-cpp](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-cpp) | Pre-generated C++ grammar tables (`parser.c`, `scanner.c`) |
| `tree-sitter-rust/src/` | [tree-sitter/tree-sitter-rust](https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-rust) | Pre-generated Rust grammar tables (`parser.c`, `scanner.c`) |

All extraneous upstream development files (Rust CLI crates, Node/WASM bindings, test suites, and Nix configurations) have been pruned to keep the repository minimal and self-contained.

## Provenance & Updating Grammars

The vendored parsers are generated by Tree-sitter from their respective grammar specifications (`grammar.js`). In normal operation, these files never need to be regenerated because C, C++, and Rust core syntaxes are stable.

If an upstream grammar must be updated in the future:
1. Clone the target repository (e.g., `git clone https://github.com/tree-sitter/tree-sitter-c`).
2. Run `tree-sitter generate` inside that repository (requires Node and `tree-sitter-cli`).
3. Copy the resulting `src/parser.c` (and `src/scanner.c` if applicable) into the corresponding `vendor/tree-sitter-<lang>/src/` directory.
4. Verify compilation via `zig build`.
